records.central_bank: Central Bank of the Russian Federation
records.people: Andrei Tishensky and Sergei Protsko (engineers, Southern Main Directorate of the Bank of Russia)
records.summary: Two engineers of the Southern Main Directorate of the Bank of Russia, Andrei Tishensky and Sergei Protsko, were detained on suspicion of stealing, with others, nearly 2,000 five-thousand-rouble notes totalling 9,770,000 roubles that were to be destroyed by a counting-sorting machine with a shredder; the loss was discovered in July 2024, a search was reported to have turned up worn banknotes worth over 100 million roubles, and a criminal case was opened for theft committed by a group in a particularly large amount.
records.source_title: Baza: dvoe sotrudnikov TsB RF zaderzhany za krazhu vetkhikh kupyur na milliony rubley (Vechernyaya Moskva, 3 August 2024)
records.detail: Passes the subject test: the people detained are central bank employees accused of taking the central bank's own money from its own premises, not commercial bankers the Bank of Russia helped to detect. Distinct from the 2005 Alexei Mishin bribery charge already on the map. The agent's original source (Ridus) is now a dead URL; this record is re-pointed to Vechernyaya Moskva, read in full, which carries every figure. Marked weak: the paper attributes the report to the Baza Telegram channel, and no prosecutorial or court document was located.
